assembly_notes: Assemble on a flat fixture; verify table stability, squareness, and that all fasteners are secure.
Fit rails and trims flush, with no sharp edges, pinch points, or exposed fastener ends.
Check pad fit and cover seams; confirm the cover is intact and wipe-clean.
Perform a final inspection of finish, joints, and overall function; no burn-in or battery handling is required.
